nodes.name: LPS stock solution preparation
nodes.procedure: LPS (Escherichia coli 0127 B8, Sigma–Aldrich) dissolved in sterile saline (1 mg/ml).
nodes.source_text: LPS (Escherichia coli 0127 B8, Sigma–Aldrich) dissolved in sterile saline (1 mg/ml) or vehicle alone was injected i.p. (1 mg/kg) and subsequently also i.v. 1 mg/kg i.e. 2 mg in total was administered.

nodes.name: Amiloride first dose solution
nodes.procedure: Amiloride (20 mg/kg, Sigma–Aldrich) dissolved in sterile saline (1.5 ml) or saline alone was injected i.v. over a period of 5 min.
nodes.source_text: Ten min before start of the experiment, amiloride 20 mg/kg, Sigma–Aldrich) dissolved in sterile saline (1.5 ml) or saline alone was injected i.v. over a period of 5 min.

nodes.procedure: MIA (5 mg/kg, Sigma–Aldrich) dissolved in 0.1 M sterile HCl infusion saline (5 mg/ml).

nodes.name: Plasma sample preparation
nodes.procedure: The frozen plasma was precipitated in an equal amount of ice-cold 1 M HClO4 and centrifuged. The supernatant was neutralized by ice-cold 1.6 M KOH containing 0.4 M K2CO3.

nodes.name: Cortex sample preparation
nodes.procedure: The dissected cerebral cortex was weighed and homogenized in a sixfold amount of ice-cold 1 M HClO4. The homogenate was centrifuged and the supernatant neutralized by ice-cold 1.6 M KOH containing 0.4 M K2CO3.
